nodes.name: 0000_snapshot.json
nodes.summary: Drizzle ORM schema snapshot for the initial PostgreSQL migration (tag: 0000_wild_glorian), capturing the full structure of 17 tables including users, teams, agents, tasks, messages, cron schedules, and audit logs.
nodes.languageNotes: Drizzle Kit generates these JSON snapshots to track schema state across migrations; prevId '00000000...' marks this as the initial baseline snapshot.

nodes.name: 0001_snapshot.json
nodes.summary: Drizzle ORM schema snapshot for the second PostgreSQL migration (tag: 0001_redundant_sauron), adding 3 new team capability tables (team_capability_overrides, team_capability_policies, team_capability_requests) to the 17-table baseline.
nodes.languageNotes: References prevId matching 0000_snapshot.json, forming a chain of 2 migration states; the 3 new capability tables support RBAC-style permission overrides and policy enforcement.

nodes.name: _journal.json
nodes.summary: Drizzle ORM migration journal tracking the sequence of 2 PostgreSQL migrations (0000_wild_glorian and 0001_redundant_sauron) with their execution timestamps and version metadata.
nodes.languageNotes: The journal is the canonical ordered list of all applied migrations; Drizzle Kit reads this to determine which snapshots to diff when generating new migration SQL.
